meta.title: AI Translation (@scottzhb-hue/dsh-ai-translation)
meta.description: A complete CAT workbench inside DSH: source and target side by side, live TM and glossary hits, AI drafts, layout-preserving DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/EPUB/SDLXLIFF import and export. On top of CAIT it adds segment merge/split, term capture from a selection, auto-saved drafts, an AI assistant, wrapper-aware routing, usage tracking, delivery/batch/quote workflows, a job layer for multi-file briefs and glossaries, and legacy Office import. Thanks to Jovi Lecca, author of upstream CAIT (Apache-2.0).
